head_commit.message:
feat(contract): needs-you-fees-overdue ACCEPTANCE + SUMMARY with founder changes

- Fees screen navigation: opens current month overview with overdue badge (no new filter)
- Singular/plural grammar: '1 fee overdue' / 'N fees overdue'
- Money edge cases: voided invoices excluded, TEST receipts never paid, due today not overdue, partly paid counts remaining balance
- Student-level counting: student with 2 overdue invoices counts once, sums remaining balances
- Added AC-11 through AC-15 for new cases
